learning_order:
**Default view: Affliction leveling (recommended by Method and Kargoz/Mobalytics; all specs viable). Demons come from class quests, not the trainer.**

**Levels 1-10**
- Sell starting gear and buy Immolate at 1 (10 copper). Then Corruption (4), Life Tap and Shadow Bolt R2 (6), Bane of Agony and Fear (8).
- Curse of Weakness (4) is optional: it now runs next to a Bane, but Classic guides skip it.
- At 10: Create Healthstone, Demon Skin R2, Drain Soul R1 (the only Drain Soul rank you need), Immolate R2.

**Levels 10-20**
- Corruption, Shadow Bolt, Life Tap and Bane of Agony ranks; Drain Life (14); Create Soulstone R1 (18).
- Skip Curse of Recklessness past rank 1. Health Funnel is optional (better with Improved Health Funnel).
- Searing Pain (18) only for Demonology with Demonic Brand - otherwise it pulls threat off your pet.

**Level 20**
- Demon Armor, Shadow Bolt R4, Immolate R3. Ritual of Summoning is group utility (only way to summon in Forever).
- Rain of Fire only for Destruction. Curse of the Elements R1 is weak - wait.

**Levels 22-30**
- Healthstone, Drain Life and Corruption ranks. Skip Eye of Kilrogg, Sense Demons, Drain Mana, Detect Invisibility, Curse of Tongues.
- Banish R1 (28) only if you fight demons/elementals. Firestone (28) is now a weapon imbue - useful for Destruction.
- Talent spells (Shadowburn, Conflagrate, Siphon Life, Incinerate) cost very little - always buy their ranks.

**Levels 30-40**
- Drain Life becomes the Affliction filler at 30; drain tanking with Succubus/Voidwalker gets strong from about 30.
- Skip Hellfire and Subjugate Demon. Spellstone (36) is optional (Shadow damage + haste imbue).
- At 40: Curse of the Elements R3 (Warcraft Tavern adds it to the rotation), Demon Armor R3, Immolate R5. Howl of Terror R1 optional.

**Levels 40-60**
- Death Coil (42) is a strong escape. Keep Corruption, Bane of Agony, Drain Life, Life Tap and Shadow Bolt current.
- Soul Fire (48) mainly for Demonology with Decimation. Skip Bane of Doom (60, bosses only), Drain Soul R2+, Banish R2, Howl R2.

**Money tips**
- Sell starting gear at 1. Herbalism or Skinning fund training (Warcraft Tavern).
- Classic Warcraft Tavern sorts ~70g of warlock training into 'safe to skip until 60' - most of it still applies.
- Budget for demon grimoires from the demon trainer if you play a pet-heavy spec (dtgre).
disagreements: Soul Fire: Method treats it as a Demonology talent finisher; the trainer list and Metabot show it as a baseline trainer spell at 48 (Decimation talent reduces its cooldown per Blizzard).
Conflagrate/Shadowburn levels: Warcraft Tavern says Shadowburn at 20 and Conflagrate at 25; Method's build takes Shadowburn at 24 and Conflagrate at 29 (both are talents, so it depends on the build).
Curse of the Elements: Classic Warcraft Tavern lists it as skip until 60; Forever Warcraft Tavern adds it to the Affliction rotation at 40 (Banes no longer share the curse slot).
Drain tanking: Method says it becomes available at 20 but recommends starting at 30.

Spec choice: Method and Kargoz (Mobalytics, search summary only) favor Affliction; Kargoz also calls Demonology possibly one of the strongest; Icy Veins (search summary only) calls Destruction weak early.
forever_differences: Curse of Agony and Curse of Doom are now Banes (Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom); one Bane per warlock per target and it does not block a Curse, so utility Curses can run alongside (Blizzard deep dive).
Curse of Shadows removed; Curse of the Elements now affects all magic damage and is learned at 20 instead of 8 (Blizzard deep dive, Metabot).
Dark Pact removed (talent); Inferno, Ritual of Doom and Portal of Summoning are not on the 1-60 trainer list (Metabot, Warcraft Tavern says Inferno/Ritual of Doom not needed).
Firestone and Spellstone are now weapon imbues that stack with Wizard Oil: Firestone = Fire damage + crit, Spellstone = Shadow damage + spell haste (Blizzard deep dive).
Drain Soul has a progressive per-tick chance to give a Soul Shard (Blizzard deep dive); rank 1 finishing still reliable (Warcraft Tavern).
Life Tap scales with Spirit (Blizzard deep dive).
Demons scale from the warlock's stats; demons are still earned by class quests (Blizzard deep dive, Warcraft Tavern).
Shadowburn (talent) now lasts 8s and has 30 yd range; Conflagrate and Incinerate are talent spells with trainer ranks (Metabot, Blizzard deep dive).
Base damage of Shadow Bolt, Immolate, Corruption, Searing Pain, Soul Fire etc. is ~40-50% lower while spell power scaling is higher (Metabot).
Meeting Stones no longer summon, so Ritual of Summoning is the only summon (Warcraft Tavern Forever).
Talents start at 10; Dual Specialization at 40 (Blizzard deep dive).
open_questions: Value of Create Firestone/Spellstone imbues vs Wizard Oil for leveling is not quantified by any guide read.
Curse of Weakness / Curse of Recklessness effect values look much lower in Metabot data; their worth next to a Bane is untested in guides.
